answers.description: A professional-grade options trading analysis platform with real-time Greeks, market indicators, and a Bloomberg-style web interface.
answers.problem: Retail options traders need institutional-quality analytics (second-order Greeks, trend signals, regime detection) without paying for Bloomberg Terminal.
answers.users: Active options traders managing complex positions (butterflies, spreads, condors) who need real-time Greeks and market condition monitoring.
answers.goals: Provide complete Greeks analysis (1st + 2nd order) with real-time streaming, deliver Bloomberg-quality visualization in a modular web interface, and support provider-agnostic architecture for future broker integrations.
answers.tone: Concise and direct — Bloomberg terminal style, dense information display
answers.principles: Hexagonal architecture, TDD discipline, separation of concerns, DRY
answers.existing_configs: Incorporate existing Python configs, generate fresh TypeScript
